newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian development secretary to visit new Congo.
newsitem.headline: Belgian development secretary to visit new Congo.

text.p: Belgium's secretary of state for development aid, Reginald Moreels, will leave for the Democratic Republic of the Congo on Tuesday for a three-day visit to discuss further cooperation between the two countries.

Moreels' office said in a statement on Monday he would discuss with the new Congolese authorities the state of education, health and food supply projects worth a total one billion Belgian francs ($27 million).
Belgium decided in late 1995 to focus on indirect cooperation with its former colony, then Zaire, through non-governmental organisations and universities.

Moreels will also seek information on the new Congo's plans and programmes to reconstruct the country, where the forces of new President Laurent Kabila toppled veteran strongman Mobutu Sese Seko in May.
An earlier four-day visit planned for June was cancelled by the Congolese authorities.
